- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.3) — reduce forecast peak by 2–5%.
- Underestimate prices during negative sentiment (negative sentiment < -0.2) — add 3–7% to forecast baseline.
- Lagged price spikes are often overpredicted — delay forecast peak by 1–3 days if sentiment turns positive.
- Overshoot after sharp upward moves — cap forecast at 10–15% below true peak if sentiment remains strong.
- Mean reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 5–10% unless sentiment confirms trend.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts tend to overestimate early in bullish runs — adjust downward by 2–5% for first 5–7 days if sentiment > 0.4.
- Sentiment volatility > 0.25 in 3-day window → reduce forecast volatility by 30–50% to avoid overreaction.
